Default Title - $289.00 USD Quantity Add to Cart     Two Crunch pedals. One enclosure. Three modes. The Double Crunch puts a complete Original Crunch and a complete Extra Crunch in one box—two independent circuits sharing only the power supply. Engage Original only, Extra only, or both for the same sound as stacking Extra Crunch in front of Original Crunch. Extra Crunch (right side) ; Original Crunch (left side) . When both are engaged, stock routing is Extra → Original . Transparent overdrive for working guitarists and bassists who want multiple voicings on stage and in sessions—without giving up two spots on the board. ▶ Watch Crunch demos | Reviews & press → No dedicated Double Crunch demo yet—these videos feature the same Original and Extra Crunch circuits inside the Double Crunch. Why pros choose the Double Crunch Two complete circuits — not a dual-channel gimmick; each side is a full Crunch Transparent Overdrive Three footswitch modes — Original only, Extra Crunch only, or both engaged Stack preset built in — both on = Extra Crunch → Original Crunch in series (same as two singles stacked, right to left on your board) Your tone stays yours — same transparent, amp-like clipping as the single Crunch Board-friendly — top-mounted jacks, ~15–20 mA draw, depending on LED brightness Hand-soldered in British Columbia, Canada — high-grade components, true bypass on each circuit Three modes — how the signal flows Right side (Extra Crunch): Black knobs and blue LED ~30% more gain than Original. Left side (Original): Cream knobs and Amber LED. Stock routing when both are on: Extra Crunch → Original Crunch. Custom routing by special order: Yes, we can build alternate paths— Original → Extra , Original → Original , or Extra → Extra . Special Orders → Single Crunch or Double Crunch? Single Crunch Double Crunch Circuits One—pick Original or Extra at purchase Both circuits, always available Footswitches One Two (+ built-in Extra → Original stack) Best for One voicing, lower spend Session/tour players who switch voicings or use the stack nightly Board space One pedal slot Two Crunch pedals in one enclosure, one power jack Trusted by working players “This is a ridiculously good pedal!” — Paul Pigat on the Double Crunch Transparent Overdrive “The Extra Crunch is an incredibly open and airy sounding overdrive. It really keeps your original sound intact while giving you a bit of amp-like grind. Killer pedal!” — Joey Landreth , The Bros. Landreth “Love love love my double crunch! sounds so nice in my Friedman Dirty Shirley!” — Marc Parent , April Wine “The number one pedal on my board. Absolutely great for getting a fantastic blues, roots, or low-gain rhythm or lead tone without coloring the tone of my guitar or amp. Just an invaluable tone tool for the professional guitarist.” — Michael Schau , blues/rock session player “Run the Crunch to taste and experience a ‘super transparent’ overdrive whose overtones and harmonics are musically focused.
